# Support-docs RAG chatbot

## Problem
A SaaS company had a sprawling help centre and support agents answered the same questions daily.

## Solution
I built a retrieval augmented generation chatbot using LangChain, a Pinecone vector index and OpenAI models behind a FastAPI service. I added citation links and a refusal path when no article matched.

## Result
The bot deflected 35 percent of tier-1 tickets in the first quarter.
